## Environment
OS, Node version, Azure CLI version, Docker version (if applicable), package version.

## Validation
Results of `npm run check`, `npm run lint`, and `npm test`; distinguish fixture tests from live Azure observations.

## Sanitized evidence
Use synthetic examples. Do not attach Azure tokens, CLI credential caches, configuration files, raw traces, prompts, outputs, personal data, or private resource identifiers. Redaction is not a guarantee of anonymity. See `docs/privacy.md`.

For a suspected vulnerability, follow `SECURITY.md` instead of opening a public issue.
